response.justification: The candidate is an experienced full-stack/web software engineer with 13+ years of professional experience and a BS in Computer Science, which technically satisfies the baseline education/experience path. However, the role is a Principal-level hardware/systems architecture position requiring SoC and IP modeling, AI accelerator performance analysis, GPU/SIMD/MIMD architecture, and hardware-software co-design — none of which appear anywhere in the resume. The closest adjacent work is low-latency backend services in D and some C/C++ IDE tooling at National Instruments over a decade ago, plus a bachelor thesis involving audio hardware. There is no evidence of deep-learning workload optimization, performance modeling of silicon, or computer architecture depth, so the gap is fundamental rather than incremental.
strengths: 13+ years of broad engineering experience across web, mobile, desktop and embedded
Demonstrated low-latency, high-throughput systems work (millions of req/sec in D)
Strong engineering craft: TDD, CI/CD, open-source libraries, teaching and public speaking
concerns: No SoC/IP modeling, computer architecture, or hardware co-design experience
No AI/deep-learning workload, GPU, or accelerator optimization background
Career trajectory is application/full-stack, not principal-level silicon performance architecture

key_factors.factor: Missing SoC/IP modeling and hardware architecture skills
No AI accelerator / DNN workload optimization experience
Seniority and low-latency systems performance background
